items.title: File Widerspruch against Grundsicherung decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald, Peter-Altmeier-Platz 2, 56410 Musterbaur einzulegen.
items.computation: Posting date printed on letter: Friday 20.11.2026. The letter itself states the statutory rule (matching § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X as applicable to social-law bodies): the Bescheid counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, and for non-tax authorities this delivery day is not shifted even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. 20.11 + 4 days = Tuesday 24.11.2026, which is the deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), the day of delivery (24.11.2026) is not counted; the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs to the day with the same number one month later: 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is not a statutory public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz (Heiligabend has no legal holiday status), so the deadline is not shifted under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB.
